name: Dear Celestina
source:
When she's not at her window looking to see what is going on in the village, she's busy finding good husbands for single girls (and making a bit of money on the side).

[spoiler]Magical glasses allow you to see Celestina as an incredibly gorgeous woman with a completely different attitude.[/spoiler]
